title: nymphozanthus ozarkanus
intro: Nymphozanthus ozarkanus, commonly known as Ozark nodding zodia, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and the southern United States. As a member of the Phlox family, it is a perennial plant used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Nymphozanthus ozarkanus include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
